prose: A guide to Grok Bot 1.0 distinguishes the product announcement from the app release and describes new team-oriented capabilities across Slack, Microsoft Teams and meetings. Its author says team and meeting sections are based on documentation and announcement screenshots, not hands-on use. That distinction limits how much the article can establish about real-world reliability.
highlights: Version 1.0 shifts emphasis toward team interaction
Author distinguishes own use from documented features
Guide is not a full team-workflow test
